card.name: Start of a new sentence or section
card.fires_on: The first word or character of a new sentence or section, or a sentence-ending period, in drug-label prose. Often it is a capital letter that begins a new topic, a section number, or the period just before a new heading.

modes.label: Sentence or section opener
modes.description: A capital letter or word piece that begins a new sentence or topic, such as a drug or organism name.

modes.label: Period before a new topic
modes.description: A full stop that ends a result sentence, right before the next sentence or heading starts.

modes.label: Section number
modes.description: A digit that begins a numbered label.

card.plain: It fires at the point where one sentence or section ends and a new one begins.
